title: Sửa 404 các REST route dùng backend root helper
rootCause: Fastify registers upload.route.js with the /api prefix, but getBackendRootUrl strips or omits /api. Calls such as /table-3d-ai/generate therefore hit the frontend/Vite origin at the wrong path and return HTTP 404 before reaching the backend.
